links.outcome: LLM accuracy generating NANDA-I nursing diagnoses from patient scenarios, rated by five experts
links.effect: All models performed similarly across domains, with Claude highest overall; small variations and occasional omissions found; authors conclude LLMs are not yet sufficiently reliable for independent clinical use.
links.quote: Small variations between models and occasional omissions suggest that expert review is still required before clinical use.

unlisted_practices: Comparative evaluation of general-purpose LLMs for nursing diagnosis generation against NANDA-I taxonomy

screen.reason: Evaluates the accuracy and performance of multiple commercial LLMs (ChatGPT-4, Gemini, Claude, Copilot) on 10 realistic patient scenarios for generating nursing diagnoses without testing a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
